headline: Wind River Acquires Keystone Wastewater Services — Pushes into Ohio
summary: Keystone Wastewater Services, operating in central Pennsylvania, Ohio, and Maryland, joins Wind River. Marks first Ohio exposure for the Gryphon-backed platform.

headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires Keystone Wastewater Services
summary: Wind River acquired Keystone Wastewater Services, a 20+ year grease pumping and drain cleaning specialist operating in central Pennsylvania, Ohio, and Maryland. The acquisition expands Wind River's commercial grease and wastewater service capabilities.

headline: Goldman Sachs Alternatives Completes Acquisition of LES from Audax
summary: Infrastructure at Goldman Sachs Alternatives completes acquisition of Liquid Environmental Solutions, the leading national NHLW provider with 64 service locations and 26 treatment plants.

headline: Wind River Acquires M&S Septic and Fenkner Septic in Pennsylvania
summary: Two Pennsylvania septic operators join Wind River, expanding coverage to Matamoras and Greentown.

headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires M&S Septic Services and Fenkner Septic Services
summary: Wind River acquired two Pennsylvania companies with 50+ year histories specializing in septic pumping, installations, inspections, repairs and drain cleaning. Both companies had built strong reputations in Matamoras and Greentown.

headline: Goldman Sachs Acquires Liquid Waste Solutions Provider LES
summary: Goldman Sachs Alternatives acquired LES from Audax Private Equity. LES operates 64 service locations and 26 treatment facilities managing non-hazardous liquid waste including grease traps, oil water separators, and used cooking oil.

headline: Goldman Sachs Alternatives Agrees to Acquire LES from Audax Private Equity
summary: Goldman Sachs infrastructure fund to acquire LES. Audax held since Q4 2017, executed 13 add-ons, nearly doubled footprint. Houlihan Lokey and Baird advised.

headline: Momentum Environmental Acquires Environmental Service Group in New York
summary: PE-backed Momentum Environmental completes third acquisition since 2024, building a regional environmental services platform in New York.

headline: Wind River Acquires Hapchuk and Liquid Assets Disposal in PA/WV
summary: Wind River expands into southwestern Pennsylvania and West Virginia with acquisition of Hapchuk grease and septic pumping operations.

headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires Hapchuk, Inc. and Liquid Assets Disposal, Inc.
summary: Wind River acquired Hapchuk Inc., a provider of grease pumping and septic services, plus its sister company Liquid Assets Disposal which operates a West Virginia treatment facility. The deal includes a 60-vehicle fleet.

headline: Wind River Enters Tennessee via Mid South Septic Acquisition
summary: Wind River's first Tennessee entry. Mid South Septic serves Memphis and Arlington plus counties in AR, MS, MO, and KY.

headline: Wind River Acquires Triple T Pumping in Boone, NC
summary: Third North Carolina acquisition in six months for Wind River, following Greenway and East Coast Resources.

headline: GFL Environmental Sells Environmental Services Division for $8B to Apollo and BC Partners
summary: GFL Environmental sells its environmental services business at $8.0B enterprise value. GFL retains $1.7B equity interest. Proceeds used for deleveraging and share repurchases.
